summary: This video showcases an Aura element team achieving over 4.8 billion damage against Level 300 Fire Guardians in the Crown Contest mode. The creator demonstrates the full combat run and reviews the gear setups and stat priorities for each hero. Talethia is geared for pure DPS, while Anneliesis stacks HP for shielding. Diantha requires Accuracy, Lincos uses the Puppet Master set, and Solmo is built with maximum Resistance alongside his resistance-sharing talent.

tips: Build Solmo with maximum Resistance and activate his resistance-sharing talent to protect the team from enemy debuffs.
Equip Lincos with the Puppet Master set in high-end Aura boss lineups.
Build Anneliesis pure HP to scale her shields for boss challenges like Crown Contest.
